description: This file defines a React component named CostsStackedBarChart that renders a responsive, stacked bar chart for displaying service cost data, with customization options for stacking dimension, categories, and appearance. It imports external charting components from 'recharts' and utility functions for shaping data and theming.

methods.name: CostsStackedBarChart
methods.description: React functional component that renders a stacked bar chart with configurable data, stacking dimension, categories, and styling.
